The '''''Dromo''''' was an Imperial supply [[superfreighter]] used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. The [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was part of a convoy that traveled from the [[Kravos system/Legends|Kravos system]] to the occupied [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. [[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggler]] [[Zeerid Korr]] followed the ''Dromo'' to Coruscant space, where he attached his ship, the ''[[Fatman]]'', to the superfreighter's hull.
